_comment: Ceilings, not targets. The design-system test fails when a count goes UP, which is what lets
the rules land on day one without a big-bang refactor of every existing site. Lowering a number
is a deliberate commit; raising one requires explaining yourself in the diff.
Seeded 2026-07-27 from the counts at the time each rule was written.
_focusRingOwners: Files declaring a focus ring outside ui/focus.ts. This replaced focusVisibleRules, which
was a FLOOR (>= 1) on a rule whose name promises a ceiling — it could not fail for the
reason it is named, and was green at eight while ui/button.tsx still carried its own copy
of the ring it had been extracted from. Two remain, both turning the browser default OFF
on a scroll container, which is not a ring.
